description_for_human: Manage ServiceNow incidents - create, view, update, and close IT support tickets.
description_for_model: Plugin for managing ServiceNow incidents. Allows creating new incident tickets, retrieving user's incidents, updating incident details, and closing resolved incidents. Use this when users need to create IT support tickets, check ticket status, or manage their ServiceNow incidents.

functions.name: listIncidents
functions.description: Retrieves a list of ServiceNow incidents for the current user. Returns ticket number, status, description, priority, and other relevant details.

functions.name: getIncident
functions.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific ServiceNow incident by incident number or sys_id.

functions.name: createIncident
functions.description: Creates a new ServiceNow incident ticket with the provided details including short description, full description, category, urgency, and impact.

confirmation.title: Create ServiceNow Ticket

functions.name: updateIncident
functions.description: Updates an existing ServiceNow incident with new information such as work notes, state, or other field values.

confirmation.title: Update ServiceNow Ticket
confirmation.body: Do you want to update incident {{incident_number}} with the provided changes?

functions.name: closeIncident
functions.description: Closes a ServiceNow incident by marking it as resolved. Requires the incident number and optional closure notes.

confirmation.title: Close ServiceNow Ticket
confirmation.body: Do you want to close incident {{incident_number}}?
